purpose: Expose canonical LearningMemory change→observed consequence→decision through /song so the artist can preserve a concrete change tried in a real Session, what was observed afterward, and one explicit decision without manufacturing causality.

lineage.outcome: The artist can preserve what changed, what was observed afterward, and what they decided, while keeping source posture and causal uncertainty visible.

why_now: REQ-SCOPE-126 is required minimum. CORE-02C/E already owns the append-only Learning foundation; consumer reachability was the missing seam.
completion_proof: new episode authority binds exact active Song and exact latest open work Session
consumer observations are USER_DECLARED with explicit confidence and optional conditions/confounders while source_ref and internal identities remain server-owned
consumer wording says observed after the change and explicitly rejects causal proof
terminal KEEP/REVERT/REVISE/INCONCLUSIVE decision requires evidence, rationale and confidence and binds the exact ordered rendered consequence set
new unseen evidence invalidates stale decision authority atomically
decided episodes reject further consequences and second decisions without closing or mutating the work Session
existing undecided Learning history survives Session close and quit/relaunch and can still be decided later
Origin, CSRF and one-shot replay protections are preserved
Song surface preserves canonical evidence source posture without exposing IDs or source_ref
authored core/HTTP/restart proof remains separate from executed evidence
review_repairs: the first consumer projection flattened all consequence source kinds; red-team review repaired this by rendering artist-language provenance for USER_DECLARED, OBSERVED, MEASURED, PROVIDER_VERIFIED, REMEMBERED and INFERRED evidence
the first card heading 'What did that change teach you?' subtly pre-assigned causality; it was replaced with neutral 'What happened after that change?' while retaining explicit no-causality copy
consumer proof was tightened to assert both user-reported and measured source posture while ensuring raw source references remain hidden
